title: Approval terminal writes are not fenced

acceptance: Stale owner cannot finalize after re-reservation; race/process-kill tests prove old fence writes affect 0 rows and cannot overwrite new owner result.

title: Center-Cut non-terminal states can resolve UNKNOWN as success
qa_comment: Center-Cut success는 terminal COMPLETED/SUCCEEDED/RECOVERED로 제한됨. actual process/reconcile runtime 미실행.
required_fix: Only explicit terminal states may resolve UNKNOWN. RUNNING/RETRYING/PENDING remain UNKNOWN regardless of failedCount/unknownCount.
acceptance: Negative tests for RUNNING/RETRYING/PENDING and no-duplicate-side-effect proof pass.

title: Batch UNKNOWN reconcile uses substring identity
qa_comment: Batch operation ledger는 command/idempotency/approval/operation/targetType/targetId exact equality로 수정됨. collision runtime/test current SHA 미실행.
required_fix: Replace concatenated row-values contains() matching with exact structured immutable identity equality: command/operation ID + idempotency key/request hash + approval/target tuple.
acceptance: Collision tests with prefix/suffix/substring-overlapping IDs cannot select unrelated rows.

title: TransactionId trust boundary must preserve official channel-originated lineage
qa_comment: CpfInboundTransactionIdPolicy가 trusted transport/system/channel/replay guard를 적용. End-to-end multi-hop runtime은 미검증.
required_fix: Official transaction-originating Channel/System may generate the first valid CPF transactionId. All Local/Remote/REST/SOAP/Gateway/Message/Async/Retry/Batch/File/UNKNOWN/Reconcile hops preserve that same transactionId. Only untrusted spoof/replay/manipulation is blocked using authenticated Channel/System identity and trust policy; do not blanket-regenerate every inbound transactionId.
acceptance: Official channel-generated ID is accepted and preserved end-to-end; retry keeps ID and increments attempt; trusted internal propagation works; untrusted replay/spoof cannot join another lineage; ADM reconstructs the full chain by one transactionId.

title: Spool root/retry lifecycle is not truly durable

acceptance: Hard-kill→restart→no-new-write replay succeeds; ephemeral tmp loss is impossible by default; disk-full/read-only/corruption/restart evidence is generated.
